items.title: The future of onchain FX could start with users, not institutional liquidity
items.snippet: Onchain FX does not need to recreate the trillion-dollar institutional market to become useful. Real demand can make smaller markets work first.

items.title: Google's Quantum Chip Beats Classical Limits in 'Impossible' Game
items.snippet: Google’s Willow quantum processor beat the classical ceiling in a four-qubit coordination game, revealing a promising hardware test rather than commercial quantum computing.

items.title: Chainflip confirms $12M hack, offers attacker 10% bounty
items.snippet: Chainflip offered the attacker a 10% bounty to return 90% of the stolen funds by Nov. 23, promising to treat the return as a white-hat recovery and withdraw law enforcement complaints.
